column1: # Plugins integration-tested in CI by Dixlase Core.
# Format: <directory-name>\t<git-url>
# Comments start with '#' and are skipped.
# Each plugin listed here is shallow-cloned into plugins/<dir-name>/ by
# .github/scripts/fetch-integration-plugins.sh at the start of every CI
# run that needs the bundled plugins (test.yml's plugin-tests / migration /
# migration-lint / comment-translation-status, plugin-api-check.yml).
# This file replaced the per-plugin entries that used to live in
# .gitmodules. The motivation was that `git clone` of dixlase-core
# unavoidably creates an empty placeholder directory for every gitlink
# in the tree, even when --no-recurse-submodules is passed — so a plain
# clone left plugins/ littered with 9 empty directories. The fix is to
# keep the integration plugin list outside git's submodule machinery:
# fresh clones leave plugins/ empty, the install wizard / dls:plugin:install
# fetch real plugins on demand for operators, and this TSV is the
# canonical list for CI to clone for integration testing.
# Adding a new plugin:
#   1. Append a row here.
#   2. If the plugin ships PHPUnit tests, register its testsuite in
#      phpunit.xml so test.yml's plugin-tests job picks it up.
#   3. Place it in the appropriate tier in test.yml's --testsuite=
#      arguments (well-tested / moderate / minimal).
# Removing a plugin:
#   1. Delete its row here.
#   2. Drop the matching testsuite from phpunit.xml and the --testsuite=
#      string in test.yml.
